info.title: Plauda AI Employee & Verified PayPal Commerce API
info.description: Headless API for Plauda: a 24/7 grounded AI employee that chats with customers from verified store knowledge, recommends in-stock products, builds structured orders, generates PayPal Orders v2 checkout links, and confirms payments via cryptographically verified webhooks.

post.description:
Create the PayPal approval link for a confirmed order.

Idempotent while the order is pending payment: repeated calls return the existing link
instead of creating another PayPal order.
Persist a buyer message and stream one assistant turn over SSE.
